t: You're at the Heyhoe Flint Gate at Lord's Cricket Ground, which commemorates Rachael Heyhoe Flint. She captained England from 1966 to 1978 and was unbeaten in six Test series. As captain, she led the team to victory in the inaugural 1973 Women's Cricket World Cup, which England hosted. She was the first woman to hit a six in a Test match, and one of the first ten women to become a member of the MCC. She later became a life peer, Baroness Heyhoe Flint.
